    <h1>The dynamical Casimir effect</h1>
    <p class="course-toc-meta">Topic: Vacuum effects and boundaries</p>
  </header>

::: {.qft-exam-body}
**Goal:** Study the creation of real quanta from the vacuum under nonstationary boundary conditions.

1.  Consider a one-dimensional scalar field $\phi(t,x)$ with the boundary conditions $$\phi(t,0)=\phi(t,L(t))=0,$$ where $$L(t)=L_0\bigl(1+\epsilon\sin\omega t\bigr).$$

2.  Find the instantaneous modes of the field and their frequencies $\omega_n(t)$.

3.  Show that under the resonance condition $$\omega \approx 2\omega_n$$ the number of quanta grows exponentially.

4.  Compute numerically the radiated energy as a function of time.

5.  Discuss the physics: where the energy of the created quanta comes from (the work of the external force that moves the boundary) and why energy is conserved.

:::
